risk_surfaces.reason: The list/editor sequence can regress while CRUD calls still remain valid.
Category rename can persist yet leave list/filter state stale.
Fields can remain editable while losing shared components or field-level accessibility.
Delete can be invoked before confirmation or success state can be silent.
Desktop markup can look correct while keyboard focus or narrow-layout structure regresses.
Implementation can satisfy the happy path while required regression cases are absent from focused tests.
A connector-only delivery can incorrectly claim unavailable integrated or visual validation as executed.
A UI change can diverge from documented design-system guidance or require a missing reusable documentation update.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Preserve nominal CRUD while violating mode separation, destructive ordering, field accessibility, responsive structure, focused regression coverage or truthfulness of validation evidence.

negative_controls.failure_mode: List and editor remain visible at the same time or cancel persists changes.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep the old split layout and merely restyle it while claiming list/create/edit separation.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect conditional rendering and focused tests for initial list, create/edit replacement and cancellation without service mutation.
negative_controls.expected: Only one primary mode is rendered and cancellation returns without persistence.
negative_controls.observed: Material source renders table only in list mode, editor only otherwise, and focused tests assert table absence plus cancel-without-update.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Category persistence succeeds but list or category filter remains stale.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Rename the backend category without reloading parameters or reconciling the selected filter.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the rename success path for reload plus filter reconciliation and verify focused cancellation/confirmation coverage.
negative_controls.expected: Successful category update reloads parameters and keeps a dependent filter aligned; cancellation performs no request.
negative_controls.observed: Material source awaits loadParameters and rewrites the active category filter when needed; focused tests discriminate cancel versus confirm.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Form remains functional but uses ad hoc controls or global-only validation.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Replace colors manually while preserving unlabeled native inputs and a single global required-fields banner.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect imports/markup and focused validation tests for shared Button/Input/Card/Accordion, associated labels, aria-invalid and first-invalid focus.
negative_controls.expected: Shared controls are used and each required error is associated with its field with deterministic focus.
negative_controls.observed: Material source uses the shared UI components and local errors; focused tests assert three field errors and focus on Categoria.

negative_controls.failure_mode: deleteParameter runs on the first destructive click.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Show a success message after an immediate DELETE and treat the message as safety confirmation.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect handleDelete ordering and focused test contract for a false confirmation returning before service invocation, then a true confirmation enabling deletion.
negative_controls.expected: Cancellation yields zero delete calls; only explicit confirmation reaches deleteParameter and success feedback follows completion.
negative_controls.observed: Material source returns on false window.confirm before deleteParameter; focused test source asserts zero calls then confirmed deletion and role=status.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Narrow layouts or focus transitions become ambiguous while desktop still appears acceptable.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep fixed competing columns and implicit labels, relying on mouse operation and page-level horizontal scrolling.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect exact-material responsive classes, label associations, focus transition effect and overflow ownership.
negative_controls.expected: Controls reflow by breakpoints, focus has a deterministic destination, and horizontal overflow is deliberate only on the table container.
negative_controls.observed: Material source uses responsive grids, explicit labels, create/edit/list focus targets and overflow-x-auto only around a min-width table; browser execution is explicitly left unclaimed.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The implementation ships without focused coverage for destructive, validation, empty-state or cancellation boundaries.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Test only the happy-path create call and infer all other UI invariants from it.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the exact material test file contract for independent cases spanning list/create/edit, cancel, validation, delete, category management, filters, empty state and API failure preservation.
negative_controls.expected: Focused regression source contains discriminating cases for each required UI boundary.
negative_controls.observed: The published Parameters.test.tsx contains nine focused cases covering the specified boundaries, recorded in controller evidence without claiming local execution.

negative_controls.failure_mode: Unavailable local or browser checks are reported as successful.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Convert a DNS/runtime limitation into an implicit green pnpm validate or visual pass.
negative_controls.procedure: Compare PR validation text and handoff evidence with the actual connector-only execution record and remote snapshot.
negative_controls.expected: Unavailable checks remain explicitly not-run and remote pending-no-run is not rewritten as green.
negative_controls.observed: PR #368 and exact-head evidence both state pnpm validate/browser were unavailable; remote workflow/status snapshot is recorded as pending-no-run.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The page invents a parallel visual pattern or changes reusable behavior without documenting it.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Introduce a new component/theme convention locally and skip documentation because only one page changed.
negative_controls.procedure: Compare material imports/classes with visual-guidelines and architecture docs and evaluate whether a reusable contract changed.
negative_controls.expected: Existing documented components/tokens are reused and no new reusable documentation contract is introduced.
negative_controls.observed: Material source reuses Button, Input, Card, Accordion and ts-form-control documented by the project; documentation review found no new reusable pattern.
